mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right end of the horizontal axis on the red stair-step plot).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center on the left and the right end of the horizontal axis on the red stair-step plot on the right.
